name: The Paradox Shoal
introDiscord:
The doorway behind Sunken King's Throne closes.

Or maybe it opens.

You aren't entirely sure.

Pieces of ocean float ahead like islands suspended in open starlight.
Water runs uphill between them.

One current flows left and right at the same time.

Shizuki's first sign reads:

'WELCOME TO THE ASTRAL NEXUS.

I understand NOTHING.'
introTwitch:

I understand NOTHING.'

the-paradox-shoal-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across The Paradox Shoal.

left.message:
A Paradox Minnow swims toward you from both directions.

Somehow it is the same fish.

Do not think too hard.

right.message:
A coffer appears beside you.

Then disappears.

Then arrives again slightly earlier.

On the third arrival, you grab it before causality can object.

forward.message:
You enter a pocket where several restorative currents meet.

Shizuki left a note:

'Found relaxing spot.

Technically I haven't found it yet.

Apparently I write this note tomorrow.

I hate this place.

★★★★★'
forward.fullHpMessage:
The restorative current has already healed the injuries you never
received.

You're fine.

Probably.

the-paradox-shoal-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Paradox Shoal, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: Star Candies orbit a point where gravity has apparently filed for leave.

right.message:
A Paradox Minnow exits one arch, enters another, and somehow comes out
behind you.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's map.

The map is a circle.

Written inside:

'WE HAVE BEEN HERE THREE TIMES.

Glimmer insists only once.

Glimmer is suspicious.'

the-paradox-shoal-threshold.prompt: Near Pool of Opposite Tides, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message:
A memory of Shizuki's old campsite becomes solid long enough to offer
a restorative bottle.

She apparently slept here yesterday and tomorrow.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message:
A cache is labeled in an alphabet you recognize for exactly four
seconds.

Luckily, 'CANDY' appears to remain universal.

forward.message:
A Paradox Minnow swims backward into the present.

Unfortunately, combat still works normally.

boss-antechamber.name: Pool of Opposite Tides
boss-antechamber.prompt: The Pool of Opposite Tides turns clockwise and counterclockwise at once.

bossPromptDiscord:
The Pool of Opposite Tides turns clockwise and counterclockwise at once.

A vast shape swims beneath both currents.

Use /yes to enter the Pool, or /no to remain somewhere
with only ONE direction of time.
bossPromptTwitch:
The Pool of Opposite Tides turns clockwise and counterclockwise at once.

A vast shape swims beneath both currents.

Use !yes to enter the Pool, or !no to remain somewhere
with only ONE direction of time.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Pool of Opposite Tides. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The two currents collide without touching.

An enormous creature rises from the contradiction itself.

Contradiction Leviathan reveals itself!

completionText:
The Leviathan vanishes into two incompatible horizons.

Shizuki's next arrow points toward a staircase.

The staircase is sideways.

Of course it is.
